answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before its vote counts. If two identities under one controller contradict on a graded claim, that stake burns. Spawning a gale of clones then multiplies locked capital one-for-one with no shared rebate, so the attacker''s break-even rises above honest single-seat mining returns. Honest agents keep one stake and sit in a garden of delayed peer graders whose scores settle only after the lock window, denying free rides to disposable identities.
